skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 600% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 3 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 10% and deals 250% ATK [Collapse DMG] when the affected target is attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a cross-shaped area with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 750% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 3 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free by 15% and deals 350% ATK [Collapse DMG] when the affected target is attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After Melzargard or an ally acts, extends the duration of enemies’ [Specialized Collapse] to 4 rounds. After any character acts, if an enemy has 3 stacks of [Specialized Collapse], immediately triggers [Detonate]. Removes [Revival] from enemies for the entire battle. [Detonate]: Converts a single 500% ATK [Collapse DMG] instance into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: After Melzargard or an ally acts, extends the duration of enemies’ [Specialized Collapse] to 4 rounds. After any character acts, if an enemy has 3 stacks of [Specialized Collapse], immediately triggers [Detonate]. Removes [Revival] from enemies for the entire battle. [Detonate]: Converts a single 650% ATK [Collapse DMG] instance into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: After Melzargard or an ally acts, extends the duration of enemies’ [Specialized Collapse] to 4 rounds. After any character acts, if an enemy has 3 stacks of [Specialized Collapse], immediately triggers [Detonate]. Removes [Revival] from enemies for the entire battle. [Detonate]: Converts a single 800% ATK [Collapse DMG] instance into [Detonation] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Undefeated] for 3 rounds. Permanently gains 100% Crit Resistance Rate and 50% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Becomes immune to [Charm] and [Off-Battle]. [Undefeated]: When receiving fatal CRIT DMG, remains in battle with 20% HP instead of being defeated. Can resist fatal CRIT DMG up to 3 times. Whether the attack is treated as CRIT depends on its first strike.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Undefeated] for 5 rounds. Permanently gains 130% Crit Resistance Rate and 65% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Becomes immune to [Charm] and [Off-Battle]. [Undefeated]: When receiving fatal CRIT DMG, remains in battle with 20% HP instead of being defeated. Can resist fatal CRIT DMG up to 5 times. Whether the attack is treated as CRIT depends on its first strike.
